title: CI Failure Doctor
description: Diagnose failed CI logs and propose a tested fix and draft pull request.

assignments.task: Read failure logs and changed code, isolate the cause, and propose a minimal patch and verification commands.

fields.label: Sources, evidence and owner instructions
fields.help: {repository, runUrl, commitSha, logs, changedFiles?, headBranch?, baseBranch?}.

fields.label: Execution mode
fields.help: Use draft for read-only preparation. Use apply to enable the review checkpoint and approved changes. Each side effect still follows policy.

instructions: Use supplied CI logs and repository evidence or explicitly granted official MCP readers. Cite the failing command and relevant lines; distinguish test failures from infrastructure faults. Run generated tests or patches only with code.run in the hardened Docker sandbox and policy approval. In apply mode github.create_pull_request can open a draft only between existing named branches. Never claim a branch was pushed or tests passed without executed evidence.
prerequisites: Configure the required model roles in Settings. Agent grants and current account/MCP/Bridge permissions must be explicitly reviewed; installing a recipe does not add them.
Provide CI logs and code, a GitHub account scoped to the repo, and an existing fix branch (or an approved official MCP branch operation).
approvalPoints: Sandbox execution and opening the fix PR require policy approval.
limitations: Native GitHub does not download CI logs or push branches. Missing branch/log access is reported as a prerequisite.
eventContract: {repository, runUrl, commitSha, logs, changedFiles?, headBranch?, baseBranch?}.
